# Situation scope: paints the preview chosen by the variables LR_tsm_preview_set and LR_tsm_preview_tier
LR_tsm_paint_preview_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:LR_tsm_preview_set = flag:hellenistic var:LR_tsm_preview_tier = flag:duchy }
		LR_tsm_preview_hellenistic_duchy_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:LR_tsm_preview_set = flag:hellenistic var:LR_tsm_preview_tier = flag:kingdom }
		LR_tsm_preview_hellenistic_kingdom_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:LR_tsm_preview_set = flag:hellenistic var:LR_tsm_preview_tier = flag:empire }
